problem_text:
A logistics company is selecting cargo containers to load onto a cargo plane. Available containers are:
* Container 1: weight 39kg, revenue 99 credits
* Container 2: weight 47kg, revenue 122 credits
* Container 3: weight 42kg, revenue 290 credits
* Container 4: weight 7kg, revenue 25 credits
* Container 5: weight 3kg, revenue 211 credits
* Container 6: weight 26kg, revenue 154 credits
* Container 7: weight 11kg, revenue 204 credits
* Container 8: weight 2kg, revenue 173 credits
* Container 9: weight 41kg, revenue 225 credits
* Container 10: weight 34kg, revenue 112 credits
* Container 11: weight 33kg, revenue 192 credits
* Container 12: weight 39kg, revenue 135 credits
* Container 13: weight 44kg, revenue 26 credits
* Container 14: weight 27kg, revenue 262 credits
* Container 15: weight 33kg, revenue 34 credits
* Container 16: weight 13kg, revenue 183 credits
* Container 17: weight 30kg, revenue 104 credits
* Container 18: weight 37kg, revenue 110 credits
* Container 19: weight 14kg, revenue 28 credits
* Container 20: weight 13kg, revenue 71 credits
* Container 21: weight 19kg, revenue 175 credits
* Container 22: weight 22kg, revenue 166 credits

The aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 403 kg. Choose the combination of containers that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be either fully loaded or left behind.
